segments.text: Tears are like diamonds in my eyes Glad you saw, now you're out of sight It's enough, it's too late to break this silence
In a rose-colored view of us, I got lost.
Could I realize all your lies would be blades and knives to stab me inside?
Who will save you from this dark?
Who will fix your selfish heart?
A one-way street, that's how you live.
What do you always take and never give?
Wide awake, yeah I've crossed the line I'm coming home, I'm running back to real life To the start, where I could breathe in freely, baby

Can't you see we run out of time Chasing happiness while you get what you need There's nothing left of us But bleeding blades and knives tonight You'll know how it feels A one-way street, that's how you leave Why do you always take and never leave?
I'll walk away to help you see Our love is rolling down so easily A one-way street
A one-way street you'll never give I'll walk away so easily
